summary: Air Industries Group filed an 8-K regarding an amendment to its merger agreement with Tenax Aerospace Acquisition, LLC, dated Feb 16, 2026. The amendment modifies the definition of AIR Net Indebtedness to mitigate the impact of a $1,971,070 prepayment from a customer on the share consideration to be issued to Tenax members. No price per share, premium, or break fee is stated. The merger involves AIR as target and Tenax as acquirer via a transitory merger sub. No board recommendation or advisors are named. Close timeline and regulatory clock are not disclosed. Watch for shareholder vote and closing conditions.
